pages.text:
Banzi and Gogo
love to garden.

Gogo’s garden has vegetables, flowers
and Banzi’s favourite – bees!

“Buzz-buzz,”
says Banzi.
pages.action: Banzi and Gogo garden; Banzi buzzes at the bees
pages.change: We meet Banzi, Gogo and the bees Banzi loves in Gogo's garden

notes: wide paper-collage garden: sunflowers and bees on the left, Gogo among tomato plants on the right
Banzi sits among the flowers with a bee on Banzi's back
illustration.only_in_image: A bee rides on Banzi's back while Banzi gardens; Gogo works in the vegetable bed while Banzi is among the sunflowers.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
“Buzz-buzz,”
says Gogo.

“Buzz-buzz,”
say the bees.

The bees sit on
sunflowers and
buzz around the
garden while
Banzi and Gogo
garden.
pages.action: Gogo and the bees answer Banzi's buzz
pages.change: Gogo and the bees join the buzzing; the bees settle on the sunflowers

notes: Gogo's large collage head on the left, decorated quotation marks around her
a bee loops away on a dotted flight path toward a big sunflower
illustration.only_in_image: Dotted flight lines show the bee's looping path from Gogo to the sunflower.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Time to leave!

Banzi waves goodbye to each bee.

“Bye-bye,
busy bees,”
Banzi says.

“Buzz-buzz,”
the bees say.
pages.action: Banzi waves goodbye to each bee
pages.change: They leave the garden; Banzi says goodbye to the bees

notes: Banzi waves with one long arm; bees fly off on dotted loops across the empty right page

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
After a few days,
Gogo and Banzi go
to check on the garden.

The bees are gone.

The flowers have
also disappeared!
pages.action: Gogo and Banzi return and find the garden bare
pages.change: Days later the bees and the flowers are gone

notes: the same garden is drawn in browns: bare stalks, fallen petals, dull vegetable beds
Banzi holds Gogo's hand at the edge
illustration.only_in_image: The garden is drawn dried and brown, with fallen petals on the ground: the picture shows the flowers have withered, not vanished.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text:
“Yho! Yho! Yho!” Banzi says.

“Gogo, the bees are gone!”

“Oh no!” says Gogo.

“Don’t worry, I have a magic trick to call
them right back!”
pages.action: Banzi cries out; Gogo promises a magic trick
pages.change: Banzi is upset; Gogo says she has a magic trick to call the bees back

notes: two figures on a blank page: Banzi with both arms flung up, Gogo reaching out calmly
illustration.only_in_image: Banzi throws both arms overhead in dismay while Gogo reaches toward Banzi calmly.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
“Mmm… magic!” Banzi says.

“First, we need to plant
new flowers,” says Gogo.

“Then, we
need to leave
a bucket of water
in the garden.”
pages.action: Gogo explains the steps: plant flowers, leave water
pages.change: The trick is revealed as two steps: new flowers and a bucket of water

notes: a large blue hand holding striped seeds; a grey bucket under falling raindrops

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Gogo and Banzi plant
sunflower seeds and leave the
bucket of water in the garden.
pages.action: They plant sunflower seeds and set down the bucket
pages.change: They plant the seeds and leave the bucket

notes: both kneel on map-paper soil, each placing a striped seed
the bucket stands at the left, filled with a photo of blue sky
illustration.only_in_image: The bucket's water is a cut-out of blue sky with clouds; the soil is collaged from old street maps.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Before they leave,
Gogo stands in the
middle of the garden,
raises up her right hand
and says:

“Busy, busy bees. Busy, busy
bees. Come back to Banzi!”

“Busy, busy bees. Busy, busy
bees. Come back to me!”

Banzi whispers after Gogo.
pages.action: Gogo chants to call the bees; Banzi whispers it after her
pages.change: Gogo says the calling words, and Banzi repeats them in a whisper

notes: seen from behind, Gogo and Banzi both raise an arm toward the sky over a low brown hill
illustration.only_in_image: Banzi raises an arm just like Gogo, copying her gesture as well as her words.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Banzi and Gogo check
the garden every day
for a week.
pages.action: They check the garden daily for a week
pages.change: A week of daily checking begins

notes: Banzi carries the bucket; grey clouds above
the seeds are drawn under the soil in a row, as if seen through the ground
illustration.only_in_image: Grey clouds hang overhead, and the seeds are shown lying under the soil in a cut-away view.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.action: Banzi looks and points; nothing shows above ground
pages.change: Nothing has come up yet, but the picture shows roots growing below
pages.question_created: Is something happening that they cannot see?

notes: the seeds under the soil now have white roots
Banzi stands on the right, pointing
illustration.only_in_image: Under the ground every seed has put out roots: the reader sees growth while the text says nothing has happened.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.action: Gogo looks; still nothing above ground
pages.change: Still nothing for Gogo and Banzi, but green shoots now curl up from every seed

notes: same composition as the previous spread; green shoots now rise from each rooted seed
Gogo stands on the right where Banzi stood
illustration.only_in_image: Green shoots have sprouted from every seed: the picture runs ahead of the words, which repeat that nothing has happened.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
The bees are back!

Banzi and Gogo laugh as the
bees dance from flower to flower.
pages.action: The bees return; Banzi and Gogo laugh and dance
pages.change: The bees are back and Banzi and Gogo laugh as they dance among the flowers
pages.page_turn_note: last story spread; the back page is a vignette of Banzi among sunflowers (skipped)

notes: huge sunflowers and a bright patterned garden fill the spread
Gogo and Banzi are drawn mid-dance on the green hill
illustration.only_in_image: The sunflowers have grown tall and the garden is in full colour again, showing why the bees came back (flowers and water, not magic); Gogo and Banzi are dancing too.
